Full inbox and imported-benchmark snapshots remain exactly unchanged, including names, bytes, mode, inode/device, link counts, symlink targets and mtime.

Actual import reports benchmarkCount1, expected inbox/<peer>/<manifest> path, exact bench.json/bench.sig/auditor.pub bytes, trusted integrity/admission and no overrides; existing seed package and benchmark snapshots remain unchanged.
